tasks.instruction: On the Deployer, stage v7_status/local/savedsearches.conf with [V7 cluster status] and search=index=source_logs | stats count. Add an appropriate app metadata definition if sharing beyond the owner.

Publish through SHC operations or splunk apply shcluster-bundle -target https://sh01:8089 on deployer01. Advance the phased job to completion. Inspect the report and default source on all three members. Member local overrides and existing lookup data are preserved.
